player_prompt.intro:
A lé mi do 2048 lé tọn to {board_size}x{board_size} tọn mẹ. Awhàn towe wẹ nado jẹ {target_tile} tile gbọn fifọ́n nọmba he yin dopo lẹ po!
Awhàn he sọgbe: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles lẹ nọ yin fifọ́n to whenue ye nọ gbọn, bo nọ yin didoakọnna.
